definitions.full: H4383. mikshol מִכְשׁוֺל noun masculine Jer 6:21 a stumbling, means or occasion of stumbling, stumbling-block ; — ׳מ absolute Isa 8:14 3 t., מִכְשֹׁל Lev 19:14 ; construct מִכְשׁוֺל 1Sam 25:31 6 t. Ezekiel; plural מִכְשֹׁלִים Jer 6:21 + Ezek 21:20 ᵑ0 (Co and others מֻכְשָׁלִים , see below ); — 1 stumbling , מ ׳צוּר Isa 8:14 (fig) a rock of stumbling (i.e. over which one stumbles); literal הַמִּכְשֹׁלִים הַרְבֵּה Ezek 21:20 an abundance of stumblings, falls (si vera lectio; ᵐ5 . οἱ ἀσθενοῦντες, apparently reading participle, compare Sm; so Co Da (as a possibility), i.e. מֻכְשָׁלִים Hoph`al Participle of כשׁל = those who have stumbled or been overthrown ). 2 means, or occasion of stumbling, stumbling-block ; a literal Lev 19:14 . b. figurative of misfortune, calamity Paslm Lev 119:165; in divine judgment Jer 6:21 ; Ezek 3:20 , as a hindrance to restoration of people Isa 57:14 . c. in ethical sense ׳מ עֲוֺנָם Ezek 7:19 a stumbling-block of (i.e. occasioning) their iniquity , so 14:3-4 , 7 ; 18:30 ; 44:12 (mostly with reference to idols.). d. ׳מ לֵב 1Sam 25:31 a stumbling-block of heart i.e. ground for remorse.
